records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは普段、どんな本読むの？
records.en_original: Ao, what kind of books do you read?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, what kind of books do you read?
records.en: Ao-chan, what kind of books do you read?

records.jp: ライトノベルとか……。<CR>ほら、こういう挿絵がついてるやつ
records.en_original: Mm, YA novels and stuff. The kind that have pictures in them, like this!
records.en_auxiliary: Mm, YA novels and stuff. The kind that have pictures in them, like this!
records.en: Light novels and stuff...<CR>You know, the kind with illustrations like these.

records.jp: へえ、キレイな絵
records.en_original: Ooh, pretty.
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, pretty.
records.en: Ooh, pretty.

records.jp: これアニメ化もしててね、アクションシーンの<CR>作画が神ってて……
records.en_original: This one was made into an anime. The animation in the action scenes was majorly cool, and—
records.en_auxiliary: This one was made into an anime. The animation in the action scenes was majorly cool, and—
records.en: This one got an anime adaptation too, and the animation<CR>in the action scenes is god-tier...

records.jp: ふふ、何だかテンション高いね、愛央ちゃん。<CR>ちょっとかわいい
records.en_original: Hehe, look at you, all excited. How cute.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, look at you, all excited. How cute.
records.en: Hehe, you're really excited, Ao-chan.<CR>It's kind of cute.

records.jp: あっ……ごめん、一人で盛り上がっちゃって
records.en_original: Ah... Sorry, got a little carried away.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... Sorry, got a little carried away.
records.en: Ah... Sorry, got a little carried away.

records.jp: オカルト雑誌とか……
records.en_original: Occult magazines and stuff, I guess...
records.en_auxiliary: Occult magazines and stuff, I guess...
records.en: Occult magazines and stuff, I guess...

records.jp: オカルト？　心霊写真とか、そういうの？
records.en_original: Occult? You mean things like spirit photography?
records.en_auxiliary: Occult? You mean things like spirit photography?
records.en: Occult? You mean things like spirit photography?

records.jp: 他にもＵＦＯ、ＵＭＡ、超常現象に古代文明……。<CR>それに、超能力！　ロマンだよねえ
records.en_original: And UFOs, cryptozoology, the paranormal, ancient civilizations... And ESP! It really makes you think, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: And UFOs, cryptozoology, the paranormal, ancient civilizations... And ESP! It really makes you think, you know?
records.en: There are also UFOs, cryptids, paranormal phenomena, ancient civilizations...<CR>And psychic powers! There is such romance to it all.

records.jp: じゃあ、ここは愛央ちゃんにとっては夢の世界だね。<CR>いっぱい不思議なことが起こるし
records.en_original: This place must be like your dream come true then. All kinds of strange things happen here.
records.en_auxiliary: This place must be like your dream come true then. All kinds of strange things happen here.
records.en: Then this must be a dream world for you, Ao-chan.<CR>So many strange things happen here.

records.jp: あー……でも、いざ当事者になってみると、<CR>いろいろ大変でロマン感じてる場合じゃないかも
records.en_original: Ahh... But now that I'm experiencing it myself, I don't even have time to think about it.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh... But now that I'm experiencing it myself, I don't even have time to think about it.
records.en: Ah... But now that I am actually caught up in it myself,<CR>things are so difficult that I may not have time to feel the romance.

records.jp: リフレクターの力を使う時は<CR>ちょっとテンション上がるけどね！
records.en_original: Using my Reflector powers is exciting, though!
records.en_auxiliary: Using my Reflector powers is exciting, though!
records.en: When I use my Reflector powers,<CR>I do get a little excited!

records.jp: うん。知ってる。<CR>その時の愛央ちゃん、いつもより楽しそう
records.en_original: You do always look like you're enjoying yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: You do always look like you're enjoying yourself.
records.en: Yeah, I know.<CR>You always look happier than usual then, Ao-chan.

records.jp: う、他人に言われると急に恥ずかしくなってきた
records.en_original: I-it's actually a little embarrassing to be told that by another person.
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's actually a little embarrassing to be told that by another person.
records.en: I-it's actually a little embarrassing to be told that by another person.

records.jp: そういうこころは、いつもどんな本読んでるの？
records.en_original: What about you, Kokoro? What do you like to read?
records.en_auxiliary: What about you, Kokoro? What do you like to read?
records.en: What about you, Kokoro? What do you like to read?

records.jp: うーんと……小説とかはあんまり読まないかも。<CR>ファッション雑誌くらいかな？
records.en_original: Hmm... I don't really read novels or anything. Mostly just fashion magazines.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I don't really read novels or anything. Mostly just fashion magazines.
records.en: Hmm... I don't really read novels or anything.<CR>Mostly just fashion magazines.

records.jp: ファッション雑誌かー。なんか意外かも。<CR>こころって、そういうのあんまり興味ないと思ってた
records.en_original: Fashion magazines, huh? Not what I expected. I didn't think you'd be into that kind of thing.
records.en_auxiliary: Fashion magazines, huh? Not what I expected. I didn't think you'd be into that kind of thing.
records.en: Fashion magazines? That is kind of unexpected.<CR>I thought you were not very interested in that sort of thing, Kokoro.

records.jp: ふふ。オシャレには結構敏感なのです
records.en_original: Hehe. I'm quite fashion-conscious, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I'm quite fashion-conscious, you know?
records.en: Hehe. I am actually quite sensitive to fashion trends.

records.jp: 言われてみれば、普段からメイクとかもしてるよね
records.en_original: Come to think of it, you do always have makeup and stuff on.
records.en_auxiliary: Come to think of it, you do always have makeup and stuff on.
records.en: Come to think of it, you do always have makeup and stuff on.

records.jp: ファッション雑誌ね。なんか納得。<CR>こころって、結構オシャレさんだよね
records.en_original: That makes sense. You are pretty fashionable.
records.en_auxiliary: That makes sense. You are pretty fashionable.
records.en: That makes sense.<CR>You are pretty fashionable.

records.jp: ふふ、ありがと。<CR>愛央ちゃんはファッションとか、興味ない？
records.en_original: Hehe, why thank you. Are you not interested in fashion?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, why thank you. Are you not interested in fashion?
records.en: Hehe, thanks.<CR>Are you interested in fashion, Ao-chan?

records.jp: ないわけじゃないけど、<CR>これまであんまり気にしてこなかったかも……
records.en_original: It's not that I'm not interested, I just haven't paid much attention to it before.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not that I'm not interested, I just haven't paid much attention to it before.
records.en: It's not that I'm not interested,<CR>I just haven't paid much attention to it before.

records.jp: よし！　私もこころを見習って<CR>雑誌でオシャレの勉強でもしてみようかな！
records.en_original: Well, maybe I'll take a leaf out of your book and start studying with those magazines!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, maybe I'll take a leaf out of your book and start studying with those magazines!
records.en: All right! Maybe I should follow your example, Kokoro,<CR>and study fashion through magazines!

records.jp: ……学校の図書室に<CR>そういう雑誌なんて置いてあるかな？
records.en_original: I wonder if they have magazines at a school library?
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder if they have magazines at a school library?
records.en: ...I wonder whether the school library<CR>would have magazines like that.

records.jp: はっ、確かに……。<CR>んー……せっかくやる気になったのに
records.en_original: Oh, good point... Grr, I was just feeling motivated too.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, good point... Grr, I was just feeling motivated too.
records.en: Oh, good point...<CR>Grr, I was just feeling motivated too.

records.jp: 簡単なメイクくらいなら、<CR>今度わたしが教えてあげるよ
records.en_original: Why don't I give you some basic makeup tips sometime?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't I give you some basic makeup tips sometime?
records.en: Why don't I give you some<CR>basic makeup tips sometime?

records.jp: ホント？　それじゃあお願いしちゃおうかなー
records.en_original: Really? Maybe I'll take you up on that offer.
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Maybe I'll take you up on that offer.
records.en: Really? Maybe I'll take you up on that offer.

records.jp: ふふ、任せといて
records.en_original: Hehe, I hope you do.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I hope you do.
records.en: Hehe, I hope you do.

records.jp: ……せっかくだし、こころもこういうラノベとか、<CR>漫画とか、読んでみない？
records.en_original: Well, we're already here... Why don't you try reading a YA novel or manga?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, we're already here... Why don't you try reading a YA novel or manga?
records.en: ...Since we are here, why do you not try<CR>a light novel like this, or some manga, Kokoro?

records.jp: んー……<CR>でも、どういうの読んだらいいかわからないなあ
records.en_original: Mm, maybe... But I don't know where to start.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm, maybe... But I don't know where to start.
records.en: Hmm...<CR>But I do not know what I should start with.

records.jp: おすすめ紹介するよ！　好きなジャンルとかある？<CR>ドラマとか、映画とかの好みでもいいんだけど
records.en_original: I'll give you some recommendations! Do you have a favorite genre? What kind of movies do you like?
records.en_auxiliary: I'll give you some recommendations! Do you have a favorite genre? What kind of movies do you like?
records.en: I will recommend something! Do you have a favorite genre?<CR>Your preferences in TV dramas or movies would work too.

records.jp: それだったら、恋愛モノ……とかかな？
records.en_original: Hmm... Maybe romance, then?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Maybe romance, then?
records.en: Hmm... Maybe romance, then?

records.jp: おっけー！　それじゃあこの辺かな……。<CR>それともこっちかなー……
records.en_original: Okay! In that case, maybe something around here... Or maybe over here...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! In that case, maybe something around here... Or maybe over here...
records.en: Okay! In that case, maybe something around here...<CR>Or maybe over here...

records.jp: ふふっ
records.en_original: Hehe.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe.
records.en: Hehe.

records.jp: ……？　私、なんか変なこと言った？
records.en_original: Hmm? Did I say something weird?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm? Did I say something weird?
records.en: Hmm? Did I say something weird?

records.jp: ううん。愛央ちゃんがすごく楽しそうだったから、<CR>ついつられて笑っちゃった
records.en_original: No, no. It's just that you look like you're having so much fun! I couldn't help but laugh.
records.en_auxiliary: No, no. It's just that you look like you're having so much fun! I couldn't help but laugh.
records.en: No. You looked like you were having so much fun, Ao-chan,<CR>that I couldn't help laughing too.
